rationale: dashboard-table-column-formatting.spec.js already has 6 solid tests (field type toggle, custom unit, text/bg colors, conditional styling, alignment, auto-color). It covers the core formatting controls but never enters the dialog via the column-header tune icon, never tests cancel, never tests remove-override, and never asserts the empty state. All of those are WIRED and belong in the same spec file — append 4 new test() blocks.
